answer: Because the timing is published against the saffron challenge, the hollow audit can replay the bridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 74 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 810 identities would post 2913 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
